== Biography ==
Eleanor was the daughter of [[Glasgow-2054|Samuel Glasgow]] and [[McCormack-3356|Ann McCormick]]. 

Eleanor Glasgow married James Crawford (1817)  in Northern Ireland, most likely Tyrone in 1839.== Research Notes ==

=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-2054]] is assessed at 82% (probable). The Crawford family tree written c.1888 identifies Eleanor as Samuel Glasgow and Ann McCormick’s daughter, with an 1839 Tyrone marriage fitting the generation. It coheres with the Gortin family but remains a descendant compilation; the 1884 Ellen Glasgow death is not an established match.

Selected father-profile identity and paternal relationship; maternal identity is separate.

Next useful test: Inspect the Crawford manuscript and Eleanor’s original marriage evidence.

Source basis already held: [https://www.wikitree.com/wiki/Glasgow-2885 From the Crawford Family Tree, compiled by William Crawford a Great Grandfather of an Australian Descendant. Written c 1888.]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.


Birth date is just a guess.  James Crawford came to Australia late in life.  No mention of Eleanor going to Australia so it is presumed she had died in Ireland.
* Death index entry: Ellen Glasgow, 12 September 1884, aged 66, Magherafelt district, D/1884/183/1022/7/459. [https://geni.nidirect.gov.uk/search/death GRONI death index].
